sections.title: One more personality word
sections.content: nyitott ("open") describes someone open to new people and experiences — a natural personality word for this unit's theme of making friends.

items.spanish: Petra nagyon nyitott, ezért sok barátja van.
items.english: Petra is very open, so she has a lot of friends.

sections.content: sok barátja van reuses the have-construction from A1 plus the 3rd-person possessive from Unit 3 — barátja is "his/her friend", built exactly the way apja and anyja were.
